findings: Large focal yellowish hard exudate plaque located temporal to the macula
Multiple discrete cotton wool spots scattered along superior and inferior arcades
Focal microaneurysms and dot hemorrhages in superior temporal quadrant
Mild retinal edema adjacent to temporal exudate plaque
Normal vessel branching pattern with localized mild tortuosity
maculaStatus: Hard exudates encroaching temporal foveal margin; macular edema suspected.
opticDiscStatus: Optic disc margins distinct, normal rim color, CDR 0.35.
riskIndicators: Risk of macular edema progression given proximity of hard exudate plaque to fovea
Cotton wool spots signal active retinal micro-infarctions
recommendation: Ophthalmology follow-up recommended within 2 to 4 weeks.
analysisSummary: AI visual screening identifies moderate NPDR characterized by prominent hard exudate plaques and multiple cotton wool spots. The proximity of exudative deposits to the macula warrants OCT imaging to assess for macular edema.
differentialConsiderations: Hypertensive retinopathy with macular star or radiation retinopathy considered; pattern aligns with moderate diabetic retinopathy.
